name: media-probe
title: Media Probe
description: Upload-time reads in the browser, dependency-free — probeVideo (duration, size and a JPEG poster frame via video + canvas), probeAudio (duration and up to 200 waveform peaks via OfflineAudioContext, skipped over 50 MB) and extractPptxThumbnail (an Office file's docProps/thumbnail.jpeg via a zip central-directory reader and DecompressionStream).

meta.whenToUse: An upload flow that stores a video's poster and duration, an audio file's waveform peaks, or an Office file's preview picture beside the original, so grids, players and FileViewer show them without re-reading the file.
meta.whenNotToUse: Server code (it needs a browser), or parsing Office content (a sheet or a slide) — that is the app's parser, returned through FileViewer's loadPreview.
